scenes.name: hook
scenes.text: One three digit number decides if you get a loan, and at what rate. So who calculates your CIBIL score?

scenes.name: bureau
scenes.text: CIBIL is a credit bureau. Banks and lenders send it monthly reports about every loan and credit card you have.

scenes.name: payment
scenes.text: The biggest factor is payment history. Paying every EMI and card bill on time pushes the score up.

scenes.name: usage
scenes.text: Next is how much of your limit you use. Keeping card usage low, often under thirty percent, looks safer.

scenes.name: mix
scenes.text: A longer credit history and a healthy mix of loan types also help.

scenes.name: enquiry
scenes.text: Applying for many loans in a short time creates hard enquiries, which can pull it down a bit.

scenes.name: score
scenes.text: A model turns all of this into a number from three hundred to nine hundred. Above seven fifty is generally seen as good.

scenes.name: outro
scenes.text: Pay on time, use less, borrow wisely. Follow for more on how things really work.
